description.html: This water dish is low and wide, with an irregular rim and a grey-green stone texture that looks like part of a natural environment. The wide base keeps it stable, and the low edges give easy access to water, even for smaller animals.

Its shape resembles a shallow hollow in a rock where rainwater has collected. Because it is so low, the dish does not stand out in the terrarium and blends easily with moss, plants and rocks, making it a good choice for forest and tropical setups as well as neutral grey-green combinations.
The low rim suits young lizards, geckos and baby tortoises that cannot climb over high edges. The wide surface gives your animal enough room to step into the water if it wants to cool off or drink.

Wide, shallow water evaporates faster and gets dirty more easily, so change it every day and check the level on hot days. Wash the stone texture with a brush under lukewarm water, without harsh products.
